tests.name: Customer billing schedule migration keeps BillingService constructible across the dependency migration
Customer billing schedule migration creates a monthly billing schedule only when a new customer has an offering
Customer billing schedule migration replaces the billing schedule when an enrolled customer changes offering
Customer billing schedule migration continues an offering update when the previous billing schedule is already absent
Customer billing schedule migration builds an invoice from customer usage and records its billed time range
Customer billing schedule migration routes billing scheduler emissions exclusively to the billing queue
Customer billing schedule migration keeps non-billing scheduler emissions on the data queue
Customer billing schedule migration returns no usage rather than failing when a customer has no offering
